name: Guatemala (state flag, 1838–1843)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue, with the state coat of arms of 1838, showing volcanoes and a rising sun, in the centre.
history: State flag of Guatemala from 1838, when the state's own coat of arms was placed on the Central American triband as the federation began to dissolve; Guatemala declared itself independent of the federation in 1839. The arms were redesigned in 1843.
